data.name: Bharatvansh
data.gender_notes: Bharatvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bharatvansh is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is the name of the lineage or dynasty of Bharat, who is one of the two principal brothers in the Hindu epic Mahabharata. It signifies the connection with the ancient and revered Indian culture and mythology. The name Bharatvansh carries the meaning “Descendant of Bharat” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bharatvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of bharat and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the connection to the rich and ancient Indian heritage and mythology.
data.etymology: Bharatvansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Descendant of Bharat.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bharatvansh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Bharatvansh" represents the rich cultural heritage of India and indicates a deep connection to the ancient Mahabharata epic. It is associated with the history, values, and traditions of Hindu civilization. The name underscores the pride and respect for the Indian cultural heritage and brings to mind various aspects of Hindu mythology, artwork, music, and literature.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bharatvansh holds spiritual significance as it is rooted in the ancient Hindu scriptures. Bharat, the namesake of the name, is regarded as an avatar of Lord Vishnu, and the name signifies a connection to the divine. Bharatvansh evokes a deep sense of respect for the ancient spiritual truths and teachings that form an essential part of Hinduism. It is a reminder of one's connection to the divine and the universe and can serve as an inspiration for a spiritual path.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bharatvansh signifies the dynasty or lineage of Bharat, the elder brother of Lord Rama in Hindu mythology. It represents the continuity and legacy of righteous governance and cultural values passed down from one generation to another.

vedic_reference.note: Bharatvansh is the name of the royal dynasty of the Kurukshetra kingdom and the ruling family of Hastinapur. It is the lineage of Bharata, who is the eldest brother of the Pandava brothers, Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna, Nakula, and Sahadeva.

historical_references.reference: The Mahabharata is an ancient Indian epic that is one of the two major Sanskrit epics, the other being the Ramayana. It narrates the Kurukshetra War between the Pandava and Kaurava princes, both of whom are descendants of the legendary king Bharata. The Mahabharata is believed to have been composed between 400 BC and 200 BC.

Bharatavansh is a dynasty of kings in Hindu mythology, most notably King Bharata, who is the eldest brother of Rama in the epic Ramayana. Bharata is considered the founder of the Bharatavansh. The name Bharatavansh signifies the lineage of Bharata, the ancient king of India.

It refers to the dynasty or lineage of Bharat, a central character in the epic Mahabharata. This term is seen on various platforms, including social media where Hindu communities discuss and share content related to Bharatvansh, its history, and significance. Blogs and websites, especially those focusing on Hinduism and Indian culture, may include articles or sections dedicated to the study and exploration of Bharatvansh. Conferences and workshops are also common platforms where scholars and practitioners gather to discuss and deepen their understanding of Bharatvansh and its relevance in modern times.
